option_relations.rationale: Metabolic encephalopathy is a broad category of brain dysfunction due to systemic metabolic derangements. While mitochondrial disease can cause metabolic issues, 'Metabolic encephalopathy' is too general and not directly equivalent or a specific subtype of mitochondrial disease in this context.
Uremic encephalopathy is a specific type of metabolic encephalopathy caused by kidney failure. It is not directly related to mitochondrial disease.
Extrapyramidal syndromes of chronic kidney disease and dialysis (EPS-CKDD) describes movement disorders associated with kidney disease. This is not directly related to mitochondrial disease.

Mitochondrial disease (pred_1) can manifest as metabolic parkinsonism, where the underlying metabolic dysfunction due to mitochondrial impairment leads to parkinsonian symptoms. Therefore, 'Metabolic Parkinsonism' is a broader category that can encompass parkinsonism caused by mitochondrial disease.
